claims.claim: A learning system converts a vague ambition into a testable goal, a baseline and manageable practice. It should specify what evidence would count as improvement before study begins. Use a small number of questions, spaced attempts, corrective feedback and a novel application. Keep an error log to distinguish misunderstanding from forgetting. Rest and workload are constraints, not moral tests. The seven-day cycle is an Ultimo design exercise, not a validated certification of mastery.
